mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever FEDFUNDS declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of 3-month periods where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in UNRATE exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 1-month periods where UNRATE rose by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in RSAFS and HOUST signal a contraction in consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST declined by ≥0.1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth economic regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2%), a decline in INDPRO signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth >2% periods, INDPRO decline ≥0.5% in one month is followed by positive 60-day SPX returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of 3-month periods where CPIAUCSL rose by ≥0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase exceeding 100,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of months where PAYEMS monthly change exceeded 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in INDPRO and RSAFS signal a broad-based economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both INDPRO and RSAFS declined by ≥0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in INDPRO signals recessionary risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS >4.5% periods, INDPRO decline ≥0.5% in one month is followed by positive 20-day SPX returns in >50% of cases.
